newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: New Pakistan parliament elects Soomro as speaker.
newsitem.headline: New Pakistan parliament elects Soomro as speaker.

text.p: Pakistan's newly elected National Assembly (lower house) chose Ilahi Buksh Soomro as its Speaker in its first action on Sunday.
Soomro, nominated by the Pakistan Muslim League which won the February 3 general election, was unanimously elected by the 217-seat assembly in a ceremony shown on live television.
Soomro is a veteran politician, former minister and a large landowner from the southern province of Sindh.

Departing speaker Yousaf Raza Gilani declared that Soomro had been chosen unanimously because the nominee of Benazir Bhutto's Pakistan People's Party (PPP), Khurshid Shah, had withdrawn his name at the last moment.
Immediately after Soomro's election, PML leader Nawaz Sharif walked over to ousted prime minister Bhutto. Both leaders smiled as they exchanged apparently friendly greetings.

Sharif is due to be sworn in as prime minister on Monday to take over from a caretaker premier who succeeded Bhutto, dismissed by President Farooq Leghari on November 5 on disputed charges of corruption and misrule.
